== Description ==

[[Sam Tashima]] (right, glasses, beard, grey polo, name tag, looking at cards), [[Logan Pietig]] (mid-right, brown hair, black UWL hoodie, back to the camera), and [[Nathan Davis]] (mid, navy GRIFFEY 24 Mariners jersey, back to the camera) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
